text: At its meeting of June 4, 2018, the Finance, Audit and Risk Management Committee considered the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration on 2018 First Quarter Financial Results

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Received the 2018 first quarter financial operating results noted in Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 18, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
